note: Known public class members that nothing reads. 869f135rm.
This is a DEBT REGISTER, not a permission list. Every entry is an open question that
`npm run test:unused-members` has already asked and nobody has answered yet. The check
fails on a finding that is not here (something new went dead) AND on an entry that is no
longer a finding (it was fixed, so the entry must go). The register can therefore only
Unrendered is not dead. This repository has already mistaken four deliberate test probes
for dead code, so nothing here is an instruction to delete anything. A member earns
`kind: "intentional"` only when somebody has established WHY it has no reader and writes
that reason in place of the generated one; an intentional entry is exempt from the kind
check and is never expected to shrink.
Baseline measured 2026-09-15 against v0.4.48: 64 findings, 32 spec-only and 32 orphan.
